description: Traffic intersections by main street and cross street (2025) is a dataset listed in RCRC Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Royal Commission for Riyadh City. The location of traffic intersections in Riyadh city for the year 2025. 1.Methodology Traffic intersections are mapped using the crossroads geolocation file. Coverage: Riyadh. The portal files it under 07-Territories, Transport & Services. Its keywords are Intra-Riyadh, Roads and Traffic. The portal shows 633 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-05-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is KSA Open Data License: this license provides freedom to the users in distributing, producing, and transforming works regarding datasets, as well as building upon them. The source should be mentioned in the prescribed manner in the license. (https://open.data.gov.sa/odp-public/static/en/assets/Open_Data_License_En.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-rcrc-gov-sa-portal.
